products.name: O-Wallet
products.summary: Private, local-first expense tracking with encrypted sync, OCR and guided voice entry.
products.description: A static React PWA for personal finance. Core transaction processing, analytics, OCR, encryption and local persistence run in the browser; optional encrypted Google Drive synchronization keeps the data model local-first.

products.name: O-Steam-Idle
products.summary: Local-first Steam presence and playtime controller for idling multiple AppIDs from one lightweight Node.js process.
products.description: An unofficial Steam utility with Steam Mobile QR authentication, library selection, trading-card drop visibility, persistent priority idle slots, session coexistence handling and manual AppIDs for F2P edge cases. It runs one steam-user session for the selected set, rotates larger selections in batches, and supports both local Windows use and an optional Cloudflare Container deployment.
